# Durga Sai (dsainvg) — Projects

> LLM index for the projects of Durga Sai (github.com/dsainvg), B.Tech CS student at IIT Kharagpur. For biography, skills, experience, and contact details, read dsainvg.me/llm.txt - personal info is not duplicated here.

## Featured

- [NERVI — Local LLM inference on Intel NPU](https://projects.dsainvg.me/nervi): Offline LLM inference on Intel AI Boost NPU via OpenVINO GenAI; Go CLI + TUI, OpenAI-compatible npuserver, Qwen3-4B INT4, extension marketplace. [Site](https://nervi.dsainvg.me) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/NERVI)
- [ORCH — Agent Orchestration Language](https://projects.dsainvg.me/orch): Custom DSL for multi-agent systems: OCaml compiler, Python runtime on PyPI (orch-lib), VS Code + Open VSX extension. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/software_eng_lab_project)
- [MATNETS — Matrix-Neuron Networks in JAX](https://projects.dsainvg.me/matnets): Neurons as n×n matrices via einsum tensor contraction; ~98.5% MNIST at ~1/3 parameters. [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/matnets/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/MATNETS)
- [ENIGMA — C++ crypto with Python bindings](https://projects.dsainvg.me/enigma): From-scratch C++17 cryptography: memory-hard password hashing and XOR-chaining file cipher via pybind11. [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/enigma-encryption/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/enigma)

## AI & Machine Learning Research

- [IPL Mock Auction — Multi-agent LLM simulation](https://projects.dsainvg.me/auction_agents): 10 LLM franchise agents (LangGraph, DeepSeek v3.1) bid on 369 IPL 2026 players; 68 of 77 real signings replicated. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/auction_agents)
- [Tic-Tac-Toe AI](https://projects.dsainvg.me/hosted-tictactoe): Plays against a PyTorch MLP trained from scratch, served via Streamlit. [Live](https://tik-tac-toe.streamlit.app/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/hosted-tictactoe)
- [Electric Charge Distribution](https://projects.dsainvg.me/electric-charge-distribution): Python simulation of induced charge on a conducting sphere; Fibonacci lattice + constrained gradient descent, >97% match to Legendre series. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/Electric-Charge-Distribution)
- [Circuit Diagram Generator](https://projects.dsainvg.me/circuit_diagram_generator): Renders digital-logic schematics from CSV inputs with orthogonal channel routing, SVG to PNG. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/circuit_diagram_generator)

## Developer Tools & Languages

- [AUTO DATE — VS Code extension](https://projects.dsainvg.me/vscodeext): Creates date-named C++ template files (YYYYMMDD-serial.cpp) for competitive programming. [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dsainvg.auto-date-file-cpp-maker) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/vscodeext)
- [CSES Problem Set Viewer & Tester — VS Code extension](https://projects.dsainvg.me/cses-extension): Browse CSES problems, download tests, and run local test execution with diffing; no judge submission. [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=dsainvg.cses-problemset-tester) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/cses-extension)
- [CP Share — Snippet sharing](https://projects.dsainvg.me/cp-share): Captures editor buffers and generates shareable links for competitive programming solutions. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/cp-share)
- [Circuit Maker — Minimal logic gate solver](https://projects.dsainvg.me/circuit-maker): Python BFS over a configurable gate library to find minimal gate implementations, with don't-care outputs. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/circuit-maker)
- [CSE KGP Scraper — AI-classified crawler](https://projects.dsainvg.me/scrap): Crawls the IIT KGP CSE site and classifies links via NVIDIA-hosted models, with API-key rotation and rate limiting. [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/scrap)

## Web Apps & Utilities

- [JoSAA Counselling Helper](https://projects.dsainvg.me/api_forjosaa): Node/Express API ranking college and branch choices from past JoSAA rank cutoffs. [Live](https://councelling.vercel.app/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/API_forjosaa)
- [Semester 5 Timetable & Elective Planner](https://projects.dsainvg.me/sem5): Interactive IIT KGP CSE/ECE timetable with subslot elective planning. [Live](https://sem5.dsainvg.me) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/timetable)
- [Sync Duo — Two-person workspace](https://projects.dsainvg.me/durable-chat-template): Collaborative todo workspace on Cloudflare Durable Objects: real-time sync, Kanban/Gantt views, email notifications. [Live](https://todo.dsainvg.me) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/durable-chat-template)
- [VCF Generator](https://projects.dsainvg.me/vcf): Converts Excel/CSV contact lists into VCF vCard 3.0 files for bulk import. [Live](https://vcfgenarator.streamlit.app/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/VCF)
- [Mail Automation — Gmail bulk sender](https://projects.dsainvg.me/mailautomation): Sends templated, merge-tagged emails from CSV records via Gmail SMTP. [Live](https://send-mails-automated.streamlit.app/) · [Source](https://github.com/dsainvg/mailautomation)
